faqs.a:
All construction contracts under this article shall provide, among other things, that
               the person entering into the contract with the city will pay for all materials furnished
               and for services rendered for the performance of the contract and that any person
               furnishing the materials or rendering the services may maintain an action to recover
               for the same against the obligor in the undertaking as though the person were named
               therein. Final settlement shall be effected substantially as required by C.R.S. §
               38-26-107, and all laws thereunto enabling.
(Code 1981, § 27-58; Ord. No. 551, § 19(I), 5-14-1964)
State Law reference—
Supplier may file statement, notice, withholding funds, C.R.S. § 38-26-107.
